verdict.rationale: Close's homepage lists 'reporting' as a built-in part of the platform alongside pipeline management (close-docs-34). The developer docs mention reporting metrics and pipeline data that can be pulled via the API (close-docs-2), which implies Close computes these metrics natively. However, that API route sends data out to external BI tools or custom-built dashboards, which is a developer building block rather than in-app reporting. Missing for 10: documented in-app report and dashboard builder, specific pipeline, activity and conversion report types, customization depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
